description:
Dimensions (approx.) 0.95 Acres
Amount Due for Taxes: SUBJECT TO ANY OPEN TAXES, WATER/SEWER, MUNICIPAL OR TAX LIENS THAT MAY BE DUE. THERE ARE TAX LIENS ON THE PROPERTY, THE AMOUNTS OF WHICH ARE PRESENTLY UNKNOWN. TAX AND PRIOR LIEN INFO: AT THE TIME OF PUBLICATION, TAXES/SEWER/WATER INFORMATION WAS NOT AVAILABLE - YOU MUST CHECK WITH THE TAX COLLECTOR FOR EXACT AMOUNTS DUE.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Monmouth County Clerk’s Office on March 4, 2024 in Book OR-9679, Page 5933, as Instrument No. 2024014270 and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Monmouth County. A full legal description can be found in the office of the Clerk of Monmouth County.
Borrower is a limited liability company and not a natural person, and because neither Borrower nor Borrower’s immediate family reside in the Mortgaged Premises, the Mortgage is a “non-residential mortgage” under the Fair Foreclosure Act, PL. 195, c. 244. Under the Act, “Residential property” means real property located in this State [in which people reside or dwell as their primary residence,] which is utilized as a primary residence or dwelling, and shall not include any real property which is [used] acquired
for investment, commercial, or business purposes or 2[residential] real property containing more than four residential units.
The Community Wealth Preservation Program (CWPP) solely applies to “residential properties” which are defined as real property within the State that is “…utilized as a primary residence or dwelling”. The CWPP expressly excludes real property that is acquired for “investment, commercial, or business purposes or real property containing more than four residential units.”
